request.spec:
A person may have a contact: a text on the person form, stored with surrounding spaces removed and
lower-cased, shown on the row. A contact already on the sheet (another person's) is refused with an
error on the form, and nothing is saved; a blank contact is none. PERSON_ADDED gains
contact=<contact> at the end when the form gave one; PERSON_EDITED gains contact=<contact> at the
end when the contact the form gave differs from the one stored (the empty value when it was
cleared).

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A person may have a contact: a text on the person form, stored with surrounding spaces removed and
lower-cased, shown on the row. A contact already on the sheet (another person's) is refused with an
error on the form, and nothing is saved; a blank contact is none. PERSON_ADDED gains
contact=<contact> at the end when the form gave one; PERSON_EDITED gains contact=<contact> at the
end when the contact the form gave differs from the one stored (the empty value when it was

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
People now have a contact. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec, on two runs in a row.

**What changed**
- **Database:** migration `V63__person_contact.sql` adds a `contact` column to `person`, with a unique index per sheet. Blank contacts are stored as null, so any number of people can have none.
- **Server:**
  - `Person` stores the contact with surrounding spaces removed and lower-cased.
  - `PersonService` refuses a contact that another person on the sheet already has, using the new `PersonContactTakenException` (409, with body `{"error":"contact-taken"}`). The refusal happens before anything is written, so nothing reaches the store or the audit file.
  - `PERSON_ADDED` gets `contact=<contact>` at the end when one was given. `PERSON_EDITED` gets it when the contact changed, with an empty value when it was cleared.
  - The REST view and request now include `contact`. Quick-add and bulk grade still work: bulk grade keeps each person's existing contact.
- **Front end:** the person form has a `person-form-contact` field and the row has a `person-contact` cell. A duplicate contact shows its own message in `person-form-error`.

**One thing that works differently from the name check:** the contact duplicate is caught in the browser first, against the people already loaded, and the server checks again. I needed this because when a save changes only the contact, the test helper counts it as successful unless the error appears straight away. A refusal that waits for the server reply always looked like a success. To keep the browser from working on out-of-date data, a refusal caught this way re-reads the people from the store. If someone else saved that person in the meantime, the editor switches to the stored version, as it already does for a stale save. The test needs this: Uma's refused save on a person Vic had just edited is followed by a save that must go through.

I didn't edit the spec, `e2e/support/`, `bin/*` or the instruction files.
